title: Seaside Serenity - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
✨ Seaside Serenity Highlights 🏝️ 1,600+ sq ft oceanfront corner unit with panoramic views ⛱️ Seasonal beach chair service included (2 chairs + umbrella | March 1–Oct 31) 🌅 Floor-to-ceiling windows + sunset views of the Pier 🌊 Oversized balcony accessible from living room & primary suite 🛏️🛏️ Two primary suites with King beds 🏊‍♀️💪🔥 Heated bi-level pool, fitness center & sky BBQ terrace 🚗📶 Garage parking + high-speed WiFi

⭐ “Spectacular views,” “Exceptionally clean,” “Best stay in PCB”

🏡 The Space

Enjoy a spacious, bright 17th-floor condo with panoramic Gulf views from nearly every room. Perfect for families or groups, with two King suites and a kid-friendly third bedroom.

🛏️ Sleeping Arrangements - Primary Suite: King bed, balcony access, private bath - Suite: King bed, private entrance, private bath, balcony - Bedroom 3: Two full beds + adjoining bathroom

🌴 Amenities - Heated pool with waterfall - Gulf-view fitness center - Sky BBQ terrace - Beach rentals & water sports onsite

📍 Location - Next to Bay County Fishing Pier - Across from Shipwreck Island Waterpark - Minutes to dining, shopping & St. Andrews State Park

🚗 Parking The HOA charges a $50 one-time parking fee per car. Registration is virtual (license plate = permit) Park anywhere not marked “Do Not Park” For 2 cars: two separate registrations with different emails (HOA rule)

Property Type: Condo in a condo on the 17th floor
